newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chateauroux airport appoints U.S. air broking agent.
newsitem.headline: Chateauroux airport appoints U.S. air broking agent.

text.p: Dallas-based air broking agent, Tailwind International, is to promote all-cargo airport, Chateauroux, the airport's general manager, Martin Fraissignes, told Reuters.
"North America is one area we are targeting for growth and Tailwind is well-known among shippers in the region as a cargo charter broker," Fraissignes said.
The appointment took effect last month, he added.
Chateauroux, formerly a military airfield, is located in central France.

In a separate development this week, a 140 tonne capacity Antonov AN-124 operated by UK-based cargo airline Air Foyle made the first of what will be at least two flights from Chateauroux to Miami carrying marine engine parts manufactured by Anglo-French group GEC-Alsthom, Fraissignes said.

In an interview with Reuters earlier this year, Fraissignes said: "We see Chateauroux emerging as one of five airports in the European Union - the others being Stansted, Ostend, Hahn (Germany) and Vittoria (Spain) - used by shippers for full-freighter flights and viewed as a workable alternative to the major, national gateways where traffic congestion is often a problem". - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
